notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
This update fixes the problem that the fourth stage of the animation will directly jump back to the selection interface.
After the update, you need to click the skip button twice or return to return to the selection interface.

In addition, the animation compression logic has been optimized, so it may result in a larger volume of updates.

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
The game has updated some new mechanisms and contents, as follows

 game level expanded from 9 to 12
 in the last three levels, different monsters have been added for challenge
 optimized the feel of the game operation, now in the game, long press the right mouse button to fire bullets, press the left key and space to jump
 reduced the difficulty of the game. Now you can skip the same level if you fail 3 times
 the skip operation button is added in the picture viewing link to save time for players who experience again
 optimizes the UI feel of the interface for selecting levels
 added achievement function
